name: Avatar
description:
Circular visual representation of a user or account using a photograph, initials, or single letter.

Variants & Properties:
- Type: image | initials | Letter.
- Size: 24 | 32 | 40.

Design rules:
- Use Size=24 in mobile top bars or compact rows; use 32 and 40 in cards, profiles, and Sidebar Navigation.
- To show multiple overlapping collaborators, use Avatar Group instead of stacking loose Avatar instances.

whenToUse: Use to represent a user, teammate, or account via photo (`Type=image`), two-letter initials (`Type=initials`), or single letter (`Type=Letter`).
whenNotToUse: Do not use as a generic object or category icon when an `Icon/Line/*` vector belongs there.
Do not manually overlap loose avatars with ad-hoc negative margins; use `AvatarGroup`.

behaviorRules: Render `` with deterministic fallback to initials (`Heebo SemiBold` / `FontFamily/Primary`) or single letter when images fail or are absent.
Respect exact square sizes (`24`, `32`, `40`) and circular `Radius/full` bound to Tailwind theme tokens.
Provide meaningful `alt` text for standalone user images, or `alt=""` / `aria-hidden` when paired right next to the user name text.
